paths.title: Learn chess
paths.description: The rules of chess in 21 short lessons you play on the board: how each piece moves and captures, what the pieces are worth, check, checkmate, castling and en passant.

paths.title: Reach 1000 Elo
paths.description: The course for players who know the rules and keep losing games: the opening principles and the value of time, a tour of the main openings, how to count material, the tactics and checkmate patterns that decide games under 1000, the habits of the middlegame, space, pawn structure, and the endgames you must know.
